title: How to File for Divorce in Pennsylvania (2027): Fees & Steps
rank_math_title: How to File for Divorce in PA (2027): 90-Day Consent Route
rank_math_description: Pennsylvania divorce 2027: 6-month residency, 90-day mutual consent or 1-year separation, $334.73 Philadelphia fee, forms, service and property claims.
focus_keyword: how to file for divorce in pennsylvania
pdf_outline: Checklist: residency 6 mo -> choose 3301(c) or 3301(d) -> Notice to Defend + Complaint (+ counts) -> file ($334.73 Phila) / IFP -> serve within 30 days (personal or certified restricted) -> wait 90 days -> Affidavits of Consent + Waivers -> property settlement -> Praecipe to Transmit ($66.22) -> decree
Warning box: raise equitable distribution/alimony before decree
